settings.title: App Settings
settings.intro: Preferences and defaults live in the system app-data directory (orthogonal to the shareable .duck); the API key lives only in this machine's OS keychain, read by the Rust core — the frontend and page never hold it, and it is never written to app-config.
settings.apiKeyHintHas: A key is currently saved. Leave blank on save to keep it unchanged; you can click "Clear key" below.
settings.apiKeyHintMissing: No key configured yet — asking will return a "not configured" failure.
settings.baseUrlLabel: Endpoint base URL (optional, Anthropic direct by default):
settings.endpointHint: If you use a self-hosted Anthropic-protocol-compatible gateway, put it in base URL; the payload goes through that gateway, and its retention/training policy is your responsibility.
settings.locale.hint: Switching the language only affects new turns going forward; past turns keep the language they were generated in (ADR-0039 verbatim principle).
settings.engine.hint: This slice persists and restores these values across restarts; applying them to the live DuckDB engine is a follow-up slice.
